passage: Maya loved the spring kite festival more than any other day of the year. This year she had built her own kite, with red and yellow paper and a tail of blue ribbons. But on the morning of the festival, disaster struck — the kite's wooden stick snapped in two! Maya wanted to cry. Instead, she took a deep breath and looked around the garden shed. She found a straight twig, some strong string, and sticky tape. Twenty minutes later, the kite was mended. It was not perfect, but when Maya ran across the meadow, her kite climbed into the sky and soared above all the others.
prompt: What broke on the morning of the festival?
explanation: The passage says the kite's wooden stick snapped in two on the morning of the festival.
